LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_Mannequin.label: mannequin
LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_Mannequin.description: SPEC-001. An early mutation that mimics the human form. Because it is easy to misidentify, keeping distance and cross-checking records takes priority over contact.
LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_BroodDrone.label: brood drone
LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_BroodDrone.description: SPEC-003. A lesser unit with strong swarm response and pursuit. The danger spikes when encountered in groups, so log movement routes and rear cutoff status together.
LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_ShellTalker.label: shell talker
LanguageData.TIU_Aberrant_ShellTalker.description: SPEC-011. A high-threat specimen showing vocal luring and field command behavior. Never move toward its sound, and watch the reactions of nearby lesser units as well.
